rows.author: J071
rows.title_full: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE MINIMUM AMOUNT FOR DEATH INDEMNITY, MORAL AND EXEMPLARY DAMAGES UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 386 OR THE CIVIL CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Proposes the following amendments:
SECTION 1. Article 2206 of Republic Act No. 386, ”¦ is hereby amended to read as follows:
       ART. 2206.  The amount of damages for death caused by a crime or quasi-delict SHALL BE AT LEAST THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS even though there may have been mitigating circumstances.  THE COURT, IN ITS DISCRETION, MAY AWARD A HIGHER AMOUNT, BASED ON THE RATE OF INFLATION AND THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF EACH CASE.”
SECTION 2. Article 2216 of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
       ART. 2216. ”¦ PROVIDED, THAT THE AMOUNT OF MORAL AND EXEMPLARY DAMAGES SHALL BE AT LEAST TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS IN CASES OF DEATH RESULTING FROM A CRIME OR QUASI-DELICT.  THE COURT, IN ITS DISCRETION, MAY AWARD A HIGHER AMOUNT BASED ON PREVAILING CIRCUMSTANCES AND THE RATE OF INFLATION.”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2020-09-08

rows.author: J089
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 28, 38 AND 39 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7305,OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “MAGNA CARTA OF PUBLIC HEALTH WORKERS”
rows.abstract:
Proposes to grant a LOSS OF EARNINGS BENEFIT (LOEB) to public health workers to protect them against the consequences of ILLNESS OR QUARANTINE; and presumed work-connected, ILLNESS incurred while doing overtime.
Intends to grant public health workers LOEB equal to seventy-five (75%) percent of the public health worker´s monthly salary, in case of death and permanent disabilities while in the performance of duty.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2020-09-09
